approval.rationale: Top-down dense mat of short, wind-flattened upland grass, grey-green with pale frosted tips and no soil, stones or flowers; it reads as cold, poor grazing ground for the Salt Coast, Frostspine and Hollowvale, distinct from the warm W0 meadow.
limitations: The blades carry a bright hoar frost; the cook darkens it (gain 0.65) so the regions do not read as frozen, which also flattens the blade contrast.
With the default wrap band the tile border showed as a 4 m grid; the cook widens the band to 0.4 of the tile, which softens the grass detail in that band.
One grass species, uniform density: no tussocks, rushes or bare patches.
